name: Emailchaser API
description:
The Emailchaser REST API: campaigns, leads, sender emails, replies and webhooks for automating cold email outreach.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint takes an API key as `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. Keys are created per workspace in the Emailchaser app and can be revoked at any time.

**Scopes.** A key is either read-only (`read`) or read and write (`read_write`), with nothing in between. A read-only key can call every GET endpoint plus four POSTs that buy and send nothing (`/audience/size`, `/setup/ping`, `/dfy/domains/check`, and `/lead-finder/searches`, which still uses the account's daily Lead Finder browsing allowance); every other call answers 403. A read and write key can call every endpoint, including the ones that charge the saved card (`POST /credits/purchase`, and `POST /dfy/orders`, which orders domains and mailboxes), spend credits (`POST /prospects/source`, `POST /lead-finder/imports`, which by default also bills email verification checks on the invoice, and `POST /autopilot/runs/{id}/approve`, which also buys the run's budgeted infrastructure) and send email (`POST /campaigns/{id}/resume` starts a campaign, `POST /reply-drafts/{id}/send` sends a reply).

**Rate limits.** Keep each account under 100 requests per 10 seconds and 600 per minute. A few endpoints enforce their own limits today (Copilot plans, Lead Finder and Autopilot runs) and answer 429, with a Retry-After header where they can.

**Leads are upserts.** `POST /leads` matches on email address, so re-sending a lead updates it instead of creating a duplicate. Up to 1,000 leads per request.

**Replies.** `GET /replies` lists what prospects wrote back, and `GET /reply-drafts` lists the replies the AI drafted for them. `PUT /reply-drafts/{id}` edits a draft and `POST /reply-drafts/{id}/send` sends it to the prospect through the conversation's sender mailbox. That is a real email: it goes out with the draft's current subject and body, and cannot be recalled.

**Webhooks.** Ten event types: EmailSent, EmailReply, EmailBounce, EmailUnsubscribe, LeadCreated, LeadCategoryUpdate, CampaignStatusChanged, CreditBalanceLow, AutopilotRunStatusChanged, DfyOrderCompleted. EmailReply, EmailBounce and EmailUnsubscribe deliveries carry a unique event ID (`evt_` and 32 hex characters) in the `X-Emailchaser-Event-Id` header and as `event_id` in the body, kept across retries; the other types can arrive with it empty today. The signing secret is not returned by the API: copy it in the app (Settings, Integrations & API, Webhooks tab). When the endpoint has a signing secret, the request also carries `X-Emailchaser-Timestamp` and `X-Emailchaser-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<body>">`.

**Agents.** There is a hosted MCP server at https://app.emailchaser.com/api/mcp that exposes this API to MCP clients using the same API keys and the same two scopes. Its `send_reply_draft` tool sends a reply draft exactly as `POST /reply-drafts/{id}/send` does.

This document also describes the public endpoints of www.emailchaser.com itself (tagged `Site`); those need no API key and carry their own `servers` entry.
